svg.title: The blinding of Polyphemus
svg.desc: Line drawing after the 1887 plate of a black-figure oinochoe in the Louvre (Gazette archéologique 12, pl. 1): three of Odysseus' men, two driving a stake into the eye of the sleeping Polyphemus, one heating a stake in the fire, with ivy above; cut out and retraced.
